attributes.description: Per-instance CloudSQL PostgreSQL metrics, adapted from the Elastic GCP integration dashboard. 22 instances across 4 GCP projects, keyed on gcp.labels.resource.database_id. The top three panels - Instances Silent, Max Transaction-ID Utilisation and CloudSQL Instance Health - were ported in from a separate dashboard that has now been retired; everything below them is the integration's own work, unchanged. Three of the integration panels render empty in this cluster and that is expected, not a fault: Database Network Connections (network.connections.count is not populated - num_backends is the connection count that works) and both Replication panels (replication.replica_lag.sec is not populated; no read replicas are configured).
